static_vignette: A 34-year-old male with bipolar I disorder is brought by police after neighbors called 911 for erratic behavior. He has been sleeping only 2 hours a night for 5 days, spent $40,000 on a car and jewelry, believes he has a special mission from God, and has been aggressive at his workplace. His lithium prescription was not refilled 3 weeks ago.
